notes: Pie-slice color analysis. Original reads pie3.png via PROC PYTHON (PIL getcolors) on a Windows path and imports the top-30 (pixel,(R,G,B)) tuples into WORK.COLORS; this bundle seeds WORK.COLORS from those exact tuples documented in the source's 'OUTPUT FROM PYTHON' listing, then runs the original PROC FORMAT + DATA step (hex2 RGB->CX code mapping) + PROC FREQ unchanged. Reproduces the recorded pixel frequencies BLUE 54530 / GREEN 18655 / RED 36577.
